ImageDescription.value: Boulder field at Lake Coumshingaun, Comeragh Mountains, Co. Waterford (with views to Croughaun Hill). This is part of the boulder field at the eastern end of Lake Coumshingaun (see image 1269857). The lake is an impressive corrie lake left over from the last ice age. In the distance is Croughaun Hill (grid reference S379 110). It is about 5 km away and has a summit height of 391 metres.

Artist.value: Peter Taylor

ImageDescription.value: Lake Coumshingaun, Comeragh Mountains, Co. Waterford An impressive corrie lake, which measures about 700 metres in length by around 250 metres wide. The surface of the lake is approximately 385 metres above sea level and the precipitous cliffs at the far side rise a further 385 metres to reach the Comeragh Plateau at over 770 metres.

Artist.value: Peter Taylor
